modified_caption: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The perplexity values are plotted against M, ranging from 3 to 8 on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing perplexity values from 20.0 to 40.0. Vicuna-7B (blue line with triangular markers) exhibits a sharp decline from approximately 41.0 at M=3 to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, followed by a slight increase to 39.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-7B (green line with circular markers) starts at a perplexity of 28.0 at M=3, reaches a minimum of 24.0 at M=5, and increases steadily to 36.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-13B (orange line with star markers) begins at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 14.0 at M=6, and stabilizes at 20.0 by M=8. LLaMA1-13B consistently outperforms the other models across all values of M, with Vicuna-7B showing the highest perplexity throughout the range.

modifications.claim: Vicuna-7B exhibits a sharp decline to a minimum perplexity of 30.0 at M=7.
modifications.reality: Vicuna-7B reaches a minimum perplexity of approximately 33.0 at M=7, not 30.0. The decline is less sharp than stated.

modifications.claim: LLaMA1-13B decreases to a minimum perplexity of 14.0 at M=6.
modifications.reality: LLaMA1-13B reaches a minimum perplexity of approximately 15.0 at M=6, not 14.0.

modifications.claim: LLaMA1-13B consistently outperforms the other models across all values of M.
modifications.reality: While LLaMA1-13B has the lowest perplexity overall, it does not consistently outperform the other models at every value of M, as the green line (LLaMA1-7B) is lower at M=5.
